fact: North Africa Post reports Morocco implemented a Cloud First Policy under Digital Morocco 2030, making cloud the mandatory default for all public-administration technology investments, per the ministry's director of cloud infrastructure; the article gives no date beyond its 2025 published year, which is used here.

fact: Digital transition minister Seghrouchni said at the opening of the ministry's Cloud Week that the ministry is drawing up a 2025-2030 cloud roadmap whose first pillar is a national Cloud First policy that will make cloud the priority for all new public-administration IT projects, steered by a national Cloud First steering committee.

fact: Minister Amal El Fellah Seghrouchni told the House of Representatives on 1 December 2025 that the ministry's Cloud 2025-2030 roadmap, with the Cloud First Policy, will be adopted progressively as the default option in public services.

The ministry's director of cloud infrastructure, Salma Tazi, said the ministry has put in place the Cloud Strategy 2025-2030 roadmap, whose Cloud First Policy makes cloud the default for all public administrations and is backed by a circular of the head of government.
